subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should OpenClaw adopt a supported `resetSession(reason?)` plugin hook API restricted to successful `after_compaction` contexts?
rationale: This creates a new compatibility-sensitive plugin capability that can replace persisted session state; repository history does not show prior approval because the earlier broad reset API closed unmerged.

options.title: Approve after-compaction only
options.body: Adopt the capability only on successful `after_compaction` contexts with run-owned deferred execution and focused contract documentation and tests.

options.title: Approve all agent hooks
options.body: Make reset available on generic agent hook contexts and explicitly accept that any such hook may replace the current session after a normal run.

options.title: Do not add the contract
options.body: Keep session reset outside plugin hook contexts and require the external integration to use an existing owner-controlled lifecycle path.

recommendation.title: Approve after-compaction only
recommendation.body: Adopt the capability only on successful `after_compaction` contexts with run-owned deferred execution and focused contract documentation and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged hook lifecycle history most directly connects this person to the phase-specific contract being expanded.
